title: She Said She Wanted Corn Chowder So I Made Her Corn Chowder
body:
My wife mentioned she was craving corn chowder. I had never made soup before. This is my journey. She cried when she tasted it.

Ingredients:
- 6 ears of corn
- 4 slices bacon
- 1 onion diced
- 3 potatoes cubed
- 4 cups chicken broth
- 1 cup heavy cream
- Fresh thyme

Steps:
1. Crisp bacon, set aside
2. Saute onion in bacon fat
3. Add potatoes and broth
4. Simmer until potatoes tender
5. Add corn and cream
6. Garnish with bacon and thyme
summary: Wife wanted corn chowder. Never made soup before. She cried when she tasted it.
